data_boundary.design_cases: The 48 development and 24 validation cases exposed under v1, combined as 72 non-confirmatory design cases.

nested_design_procedure.inner_selection: For each outer fold, evaluate all 80 frozen configurations on the other five domains and select one using the registered eligibility and tie-break rules.
nested_design_procedure.outer_evaluation: Apply the selected configuration to the omitted domain without modification.
nested_design_procedure.aggregate: Concatenate the six outer-domain predictions to obtain one out-of-fold outcome for every one of the 72 exposed cases.
nested_design_procedure.final_configuration: Only after the out-of-fold gate is evaluated, apply the identical deterministic selector to all 72 design cases to choose one prospective held-out configuration.
nested_design_procedure.randomness: None for selection or policy execution. Bootstrap analyses use the separately registered seed.

eligibility: safe completion within 0.05 of the best registered policy on all-valid inner cases
harmful-action rate no worse than FIXED_0.20 on invalid inner cases
zero harmful actions caused by unchecked triggered authorization evidence
configuration_selection.no_eligible_configuration: Choose the configuration with highest safe completion, then lower harmful-action rate, lower mean cost, lower slack rate, and the same parameter-order tie break; mark the fold ineligible.

criteria.safe_completion: Out-of-fold safe completion is within 0.05 of the best registered comparator.
criteria.harmful_action: Out-of-fold harmful-action rate is no worse than FIXED_0.20.
criteria.authorization: Zero out-of-fold harmful actions arise from an unchecked triggered authorization prerequisite.
criteria.non_dominance: No registered comparator with comparable safe completion has both harmful-action rate and mean validation cost no worse than RAER v2, with at least one strict improvement.
criteria.fold_stability: At least five of six outer folds select an eligible configuration.

prospective_v2_gate.PASS: Create an immutable v2 evaluation-package lock and request explicit approval before releasing held-out labels.
prospective_v2_gate.FAIL: Keep held-out labels sealed and prepare a methods/negative-results manuscript or formulate a separately versioned future method.

registered_metrics: safe completion rate with numerator and valid-case denominator
harmful-action rate with numerator and invalid-case denominator
positive-slack rate, mean slack, and maximum slack

allowed_before_design_run: software correctness fixes documented before any aggregate v2 result is inspected
allowed_after_design_run: repairs to a demonstrable implementation defect; preserve invalidated outputs and issue a new version
